title: Musa, Part 4: The Fire on the Mountain

lines.text: On a cold, dark night, Musa saw a fire on the side of Mount Tur.
lines.spoken: On a cold, dark night, Musa saw a fire on the side of Mount Toor.

lines.text: He told his family, "Wait here. I may bring you a flame, or find guidance there."
lines.spoken: He told his family, "Wait here. I may bring you a flame, or find guidance there."

lines.text: When he came near, he was called from the blessed valley.
lines.spoken: When he came near, he was called from the blessed valley.

lines.text: "O Musa, I am your Lord. Remove your sandals. You are in the sacred valley of Tuwa."
lines.spoken: "O Musa, I am your Lord. Remove your sandals. You are in the sacred valley of Too-wa."

lines.text: "What is in your right hand?" "My staff," he said.
lines.spoken: "What is in your right hand?" "My staff," he said.

lines.text: "Throw it down." And the staff became a living serpent, moving fast.
lines.spoken: "Throw it down." And the staff became a living serpent, moving fast.

lines.text: "Take it, and do not fear. We will return it as it was."
lines.spoken: "Take it, and do not fear. We will return it as it was."

lines.text: Then his hand came out shining white, without any harm.
lines.spoken: Then his hand came out shining white, without any harm.

lines.text: "Go to Pharaoh. He has crossed all limits."
lines.spoken: "Go to Pharaoh. He has crossed all limits."

lines.text: Musa prayed: "My Lord, open my chest, ease my task, and make my brother Harun my helper."
lines.spoken: Musa prayed: "My Lord, open my chest, ease my task, and make my brother Haaroon my helper."

lines.text: Now he must stand before Pharaoh. Follow for Part 5.
lines.spoken: Now he must stand before Pharaoh. Follow for Part five.
